- Fixed AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition installation reporting success when the application was missing, including with driver package 26.11.1. Installation now checks each software component and the application executable.
- Added checks for pending Windows and AMD driver restarts before starting another installation, avoiding retries while devices are waiting for a reboot.
- Added a persistent restart status explaining when installed drivers still need activation and why monitors may not flash during installation.
- Reduced unnecessary installation work by reinstalling AMD HD Audio directly, avoiding duplicate installation of the same GPU, and batching log updates to keep the window responsive.
- Verified the selected display and audio drivers before recording installation success, and stopped using receipts from a different display driver to identify the installed package.
- Added saved session logs, detailed AMD Software installer logs, and elapsed-time updates while Windows installs drivers.
